title: PP7 virus-like particles in E. coli imaged with the crossed laser phase plate switched off (underfocus phase contrast, 2-3 µm)

annotations.description: PP7 bacteriophage virus-like particle (VLP) capsid overexpressed in E. coli
annotations.method: Oriented PP7 VLP positions from RELION 5 subtomogram averaging with I2 symmetry, run with the py2rely STA pipeline. To balance the number of particles across three sessions, a random subset of 13,604 of the 17,322 curated candidates (see the curated annotation) were selected and then aligned to a PP7 VLP reference map at 9.6, 3.2, and 1.6 Å/px with repeated rounds of CTF refinement, Bayesian polishing, re-extraction and 3D auto-refinement. Deposited values are those of the particle set that gave the best map (3.4 Å at FSC 0.143), reached after the third polishing round. Orientations are relative to the I2 reference and are defined up to the icosahedral symmetry. Forty particles whose refined centre lies outside the reconstructed volume were omitted.

annotations.description: PP7 bacteriophage virus-like particle (VLP) capsid overexpressed in E. coli
annotations.method: PP7 VLP candidates predicted with Octopi (3D U-Net segmentation with watershed localization) on DenoisET-denoised tomograms at 10 Å; 2D minislab projections of every candidate were extracted with slabpick, classified into 50 2D classes in RELION 5 via py2rely, classes showing intact VLPs were selected interactively and the retained candidates mapped back to the tomograms; subtomogram averaging started from this curated set (see the RELION-refined annotation).

annotations.description: PP7 bacteriophage virus-like particle (VLP) capsid overexpressed in E. coli
annotations.method: Automated PP7 VLP prediction with Octopi (3D U-Net segmentation with watershed localization) on DenoisET-denoised tomograms at 10 Å, before curation.
Automated membrane segmentation with MemBrain-seg applied to the IsoNet2-denoised, miss-alignment-refined tomograms at 10.4 Å; probability maps thresholded at 0.5.

To balance the number of particles across three sessions, a random subset of 13,604 of the 17,322 curated candidates (see the curated annotation) were selected and then aligned to a PP7 VLP reference map at 9.6, 3.2, and 1.6 Å/px with repeated rounds of CTF refinement, Bayesian polishing, re-extraction and 3D auto-refinement. Deposited values are those of the particle set that gave the best map (3.4 Å at FSC 0.143), reached after the third polishing round. Orientations are relative to the I2 reference and are defined up to the icosahedral symmetry. Forty particles whose refined centre lies outside the reconstructed volume were omitted.
